commits.change: OR the positive candidate spans minus one before finding the highest set bit, replacing a serial maximum reduction. Its bit width equals bit_width(max(size)-1), so search steps are identical.
Reuse initialized lane code and row-end entries between batches; all output prefixes are overwritten before copying. Resize initializes only newly grown entries.

Parse up to64 rows with the branch-free loop, retaining its output. Choose a monomorphized loop for the remainder once: >=16 observed codes per row uses conditional row-completion work; otherwise retain the existing loop. Applies to Rows and Arrow. Explicit matcher array-fill loops prevent closure outlining from losing the target-feature caller's hardware POPCNT context.

candidate_isa: AVX-512F + POPCNT, detected once per parse; six flat-rank lanes. Existing tree and scalar dispatch and inline-assembly comparisons retained. No extra ISA requirement.
method: Each column ran in a separate process. Four variants ran serially back-to-back per column with rotated/reversed order, seven timed iterations after three warmups, CPU2. This session ran no builds, tests, or profiles concurrently with accepted timing. Normal round-trip checks remain enabled; data preparation/downloads are outside timing.

measurement_exclusions.reason: Artifact SHA256 generation overlapped the first baseline. All four URL variants were repeated serially after the full series, and only the replacement measurements are used.

native_benchmarks.method: Existing upstream tpch/clickbench benchmarks, native bench profile, Rust1.99.1 default x86-64 target and force-frame-pointers=yes, pinnedCPU2. Native upstream benchmarks use the default allocator; primary Vortex measurements use its existing mimalloc setup.

url_confirmation.note: Both runs retained. Initial standalone URL12 train+compress measured -2.34%; reverse-order repeat measured about -2.67%, while parse improved about3%/11%. Decoder repeat was effectively flat. The primary Vortex writer gains remain positive on all14cases. No training or decoder source change was made; the cause of this standalone total-compression regression was not isolated.
